sponsored.sum: Prohibits digital currency contributions to candidates or political committees.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing an owner of real property exempt from taxation time to re-apply for such exemption if such exemption was not renewed
sponsored.sum: Provides that an owner of real property exempt from taxation may re-apply for such exemption within thirty days of receiving a property tax bill if such exemption was required to be renewed and was not renewed.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of adhesive stickers in the enforcement of street parking rules; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits municipalities from using adhesive stickers in the enforcement of street parking rules.

sponsored.t: Requires standards for an electronic prior authorization program for the utilization review of health care services
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health and the superintendent of insurance to develop standards for an electronic prior authorization program for the utilization review of health care services.

sponsored.t: Requires Medicaid coverage of applied behavior analysis therapy rendered during school hours
sponsored.sum: Requires Medicaid coverage of applied behavior analysis therapy rendered during school hours in certain schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to net energy metering for certain residential customer-generators
sponsored.sum: Requires net energy metering rates for residential customer-generators powering up to four units instead of compensation from the value of distributed energy resources compensation methodology or the value stack compensation methodology.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance coverage for FDA approved expanded access to certain investigational medical products
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance policies to provide coverage for federal food and drug administration approved expanded access to an investigational medical product that has been shown to be effective, without the need for any prior authorization determination.

sponsored.t: Relates to handicapped parking permits for persons seventy-five years old and older
sponsored.sum: Allows persons who were issued a temporary special vehicle identification parking permit to renew such permit without providing an updated medical certification or additional medical documents if such person is 75 years or older.

sponsored.t: Relates to additional real property tax exemptions for certain senior citizens
sponsored.sum: Relates to additional real property tax exemptions for certain senior citizens.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to establish an alternative payment methodology (APM) for Federally Qualified Health Centers to preserve and improve patient access to fertility care
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to establish an alternative payment methodology (APM) for federally qualified health centers to preserve and improve patient access to fertility care.

sponsored.t: Relates to timing for a candidate to decline a nomination
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person designated as a candidate for two or more party nominations for an office to be filled at the time of a general election who is not nominated at a primary election by one or more such parties may decline a nomination not later than the last day to certify the ballot or to determine the candidates and questions that shall appear on the ballot; relates to the timing for certain candidates to decline a designation or nomination under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring insurance coverage for epinephrine auto-injectors
sponsored.sum: Clarifies coverage requirements for epinephrine auto-injectors; specifies that such coverage may be subject to the plan's annual deductible.
